title: Fascia revocation list
description: One per community. sig is the signer's signature over the canonical JSON of the object without sig. Grows only: every entry whose until is in the future stays until it passes.

kind.description: claim: fails any chain containing a link with this claim_id. key: fails any chain in which this key is an iss or an aud.

proof.description: Empty when the Community Agent signs; the steward's issuer delegation (base64url) when a steward does.
